description: This file defines the OrderSetMember class, which models a member of an order set in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for identifiers, related objects like OrderType, OrderSet, Concept, and associated templates and types, along with getters and setters.

classes.name: OrderSetMember
classes.description: Represents a member of an order set, including metadata, related concepts, order types, templates, and associated order set.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this OrderSetMember.

methods.name: setOrderSetMemberId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this OrderSetMember.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the order type associated with this member.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the order type for this member.

methods.name: getOrderTemplateType
methods.description: Returns the type of the order template.

methods.name: setOrderTemplateType
methods.description: Sets the type of the order template.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this order set member.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept for this order set member.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Returns the order set that this member belongs to.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Sets the order set for this member.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the base class method to return the member's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the base class method to set the member's ID.
